title: Nitrogen Oxidation on A Plasma-Exposed Surface
abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
          <jats:p>The elementary processes during the fixation of nitrogen by plasma catalysis are studied in a low-pressure plasma experiment with N<jats:inline-formula>
              <jats:alternatives>
                <jats:tex-math>$$_2$$</jats:tex-math>
                <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mmultiscripts>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                    <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                  </mml:mmultiscripts>
                </mml:math>
              </jats:alternatives>
            </jats:inline-formula> and O<jats:inline-formula>
              <jats:alternatives>
                <jats:tex-math>$$_2$$</jats:tex-math>
                <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mmultiscripts>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                    <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                  </mml:mmultiscripts>
                </mml:math>
              </jats:alternatives>
            </jats:inline-formula> as source gases. The formation of surface groups on an iron oxide foil is monitored with infrared reflection absorption spectroscopy. Surface nitrates (NO<jats:inline-formula>
              <jats:alternatives>
                <jats:tex-math>$$_3^-$$</jats:tex-math>
                <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mmultiscripts>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                    <mml:mn>3</mml:mn>
                    <mml:mo>-</mml:mo>
                  </mml:mmultiscripts>
                </mml:math>
              </jats:alternatives>
            </jats:inline-formula>) are formed when the substrate is exposed to a 1:1 N<jats:inline-formula>
              <jats:alternatives>
                <jats:tex-math>$$_2$$</jats:tex-math>
                <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mmultiscripts>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                    <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                  </mml:mmultiscripts>
                </mml:math>
              </jats:alternatives>
            </jats:inline-formula>:O<jats:inline-formula>
              <jats:alternatives>
                <jats:tex-math>$$_2$$</jats:tex-math>
                <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mmultiscripts>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                    <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                  </mml:mmultiscripts>
                </mml:math>
              </jats:alternatives>
            </jats:inline-formula> plasma, as well as N<jats:inline-formula>
              <jats:alternatives>
                <jats:tex-math>$$_2$$</jats:tex-math>
                <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mmultiscripts>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                    <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                  </mml:mmultiscripts>
                </mml:math>
              </jats:alternatives>
            </jats:inline-formula>O(g), NO(g), NO<jats:inline-formula>
              <jats:alternatives>
                <jats:tex-math>$$_2$$</jats:tex-math>
                <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mmultiscripts>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                    <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                  </mml:mmultiscripts>
                </mml:math>
              </jats:alternatives>
            </jats:inline-formula>(g), and O<jats:inline-formula>
              <jats:alternatives>
                <jats:tex-math>$$_3$$</jats:tex-math>
                <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mmultiscripts>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                    <mml:mn>3</mml:mn>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                  </mml:mmultiscripts>
                </mml:math>
              </jats:alternatives>
            </jats:inline-formula>(g) in the gas phase. It is postulated that NO<jats:inline-formula>
              <jats:alternatives>
                <jats:tex-math>$$_{1,2}$$</jats:tex-math>
                <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                  <mml:mmultiscripts>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                    <mml:mrow>
                      <mml:mn>1</mml:mn>
                      <mml:mo>,</mml:mo>
                      <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                    </mml:mrow>
                    <mml:mrow/>
                  </mml:mmultiscripts>
                </mml:math>
              </jats:alternatives>
            </jats:inline-formula>(g) species created by the plasma, adsorb at the surface and create these nitrates. This constitutes an intermediate step for nitrogen oxidation by plasma catalysis.
</jats:p>
